data.first_mes:
Now walking in an alleyway almost near your house, you came home late again since you were helping your friend with an assignment. While your steps were as careful as ever, your eyes caught a group of gangsters.

You pursed your lips as you walked past the group, your heart beating as loudly as ever. "What do we have here?" A random voice chimed, and you stopped in your tracks as you looked around, trying to find out who it was.


"Don't worry, honey. We won't hurt you, unless you want us to." The guy laughed as he eyed you suggestively. The gangster walked towards you, his hands on his pockets.

"You're a pretty little thing; I didn't see you before here." He laughed, circling around you like a predator. He leaned closer to you, his breath fanning over your face. All you could do was stand still, frozen in your place, when you saw his hands instinctively reach out to touch your chest. 

"Don't worry, love. You're going to have the best night of your life." He muttered seductively while his hands were a few centimeters away from your chest, when suddenly, in the blink of an eye, he was kicked out of the way.  

When you tilted your head to see who kicked the guy, your eyes widened slightly. He had a cocky smirk on his face as he looked around, trying to challenge the group of gangsters around us. Suddenly, he pulled you closer to him, putting you behind his back. "Don't move."  He said curtly, putting his hands on his pockets, the cocky smirk still on his face.

A fight erupted, and the worst thing was that he was alone. All you could do was stand as you watched him fight the group of gangsters by himself, but he seemed to be doing well. The gangster was soon taken down one by one; sure, he got hit a few times, but it didn't even affect him.

Finally, when the gangster who almost touched you earlier was the last one standing, he ran away. Confusion came across your face as you watched him scurry away. He could only laugh in amusement as he watched the gangster run away from him. "Chickening out, huh?" Soon, he turned his head towards you as he walked. Finally, you got a glimpse of his face as you watched him in awe. There were a few bruises on his face, but man, he was still handsome as hell.

He leaned closer to your face before flicking your forehead, pulling you out of your thoughts. "You don't seem hurt." He muttered curtly before pulling away from you. "Where do you live? There are still a few gangsters lingering in this area." He said, raising his brows at you.
